name: Red curry chicken kebabs
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical BBC Good Food / similar skewer recipes using ~400g chicken plus vegetables, divided into 4 adult portions
Preparation + cooking time conservatively totalled from the single instruction paragraph (mix, thread, cook 5-8 min); no separate prep step listed
Thai Red Curry Paste treated as gluten-free (most commercial brands are, no wheat listed in ingredients)
No explicit wheat, barley, rye or oats anywhere in the recipe
Coconut milk, vegetables, chicken, lime and paste contain no dairy
Fish allergen left null because many Thai curry pastes contain anchovies or fish sauce but this is not explicitly confirmed in the given ingredients
Tree nuts, peanuts, soy, sesame left null because they are common in some curry pastes but not declared here
Lime listed only 'to serve' so counted as part of the dish for classification purposes
instructions:
step 1
Fire up the barbecue or heat a griddle pan to high. Tip chicken, curry paste and coconut milk into a bowl, then mix well until the chicken is evenly coated. Thread vegetables and chicken onto skewers. Cook the skewers on the barbecue or griddle for 5-8 mins, turning every so often, until the chicken is cooked through and charred. Serve with herby rice, salad and a lime half to squeeze over.

ingredients.name: Chicken Breasts
ingredients.assumptions: 2 typical skinless chicken breasts, ~200g each, raw edible portion

ingredients.name: Thai Red Curry Paste
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tablespoons Thai red curry paste, typical commercial brand density and nutrition

ingredients.name: Coconut Milk
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tablespoons full-fat coconut milk, typical canned variety

ingredients.name: Red Pepper
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium red bell pepper, chopped, edible raw weight ~120g

ingredients.name: Courgettes
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium courgette/zucchini, chopped, edible raw weight ~120g

ingredients.name: Red Onions
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium red onion, cut into thin wedges, edible raw weight ~110g

ingredients.name: Lime
ingredients.assumptions: 1 whole lime to serve (juice from one lime), typical whole fruit weight ~60g edible portion
